zones.title: Receive
zones.body: NOTIFY result of the REFER, posted by the gateway.

zones.title: Decide
zones.body: TransferOutcome: NOTIFY 2xx releases; a first failure speaks and retries once; a second failure speaks and ends. One retry, never a loop.

panels.title: AR-04 Transfer result
panels.body: REFER acceptance is not completion. The outcome is stored on the session and the retry policy is one attempt: TransferOutcome routes to release, retry once, or end.
